docs/specs/application-flow-understanding-v0.md is indexed with stable AFU-V0 requirement IDs, each traced to a test or measured evidence, or recorded as an explicit gap.

Flow reports keep evidence basis, test relationship, run outcome and freshness as separate axes, never a single confidence score, and declare complete:false plus an explicit frontier until an accepted boundary says otherwise.

body: Owner requested the application-flow understanding capability as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery, acceptance or promotion. Outcome: Corvint discovers application flows, explains which tests cover each flow at the assertion level, reports missing tests, learns UI behavior from bounded observation, and checks whether observed behavior agrees with its understanding. Initial scope is web applications in a safe local test environment. Current state: an experimental slice exists on branch codex/application-flows (worktree /private/tmp/corvint-application-flows-work; base cd9fec9ae5ed8199ee3c844884ca4212d3e4031c; tested commit 6579676e2e7852cbe0d8097027d8508e96225448; sealed HEAD 1c1937a2608480fa12ecf6b4e2e1e62d5d88a239). It is committed locally, not merged to main and not published. It delivers versioned flow manifests, evidence and reports pinned to immutable Git content; static mapping from declared flows to candidate test assertions with explicit gaps, incomplete mappings, stale evidence and uncertainty; limited candidate-flow discovery from a supported Playwright grammar; guided Chromium execution with UI assertions and independent backend checks; sanitized DOM/control observations with an explicit unexplored frontier; served/fixture identity and source-drift validation; explicit private evidence recording with non-mutating reads; owned browser/server cleanup. CLI: `corvint flows --manifest FILE [--evidence FILE]`, `corvint flows record --manifest FILE --evidence FILE --output FILE`, and the separately built observer `corvint-web-flows --experimental --trusted-local --root APP --manifest FILE --assets DIR [--observe]`. Verified on the branch: full make gate PASS, browser gate PASS (6 scanner/lifecycle tests, 9 browser cases, both seeded backend defects detected), independent review after repairs, dogfood completion and evidence seal PASS. Checkpoint: /private/tmp/corvint-application-flows-20260922/build-state.json. Boundaries that remain: reports always declare complete:false; static test mappings are candidates, not proof of execution; inferred expectations are hypotheses, not authority; roles are caller-declared-unverified; browser activity is limited to the declared loopback origin and the server is trusted local code, not OS-sandboxed; general framework discovery, unsupported test syntax, escaped-daemon cleanup and non-HTTP transports are unqualified; the advisory frontier is OPEN with 64 acknowledged evidence-quality items. Owning spec: docs/specs/application-flow-understanding-v0.md (AFU-V0-001..AFU-V0-012, intent proposed, delivery experimental). Remaining work for 0.7.0: land the branch on main through normal review, keep the spec indexed in docs/specs/README.md and REQUIREMENTS.tsv, broaden discovery and verification within declared boundaries without an exhaustive-coverage claim, and obtain explicit owner acceptance of the profile before any promotion; contract acceptance was not authorized as of this ticket.

completion.reason: Completed as delivered-experimental by decision 0373 item 15. Evidence digests: sha256 of docs/decisions/0373-corvint-1.0-scope-ratified-2026-09-23.md and of docs/specs/application-flow-understanding-v0.md (indexed with AFU-V0 requirement IDs). The codex/application-flows slice is merged (57765fb, 70f531b), the browser gate ran on base a98d770, the dogfood binding is sealed (3f60009, 2a14291), reports stay complete:false with an explicit frontier, and profile acceptance remains an owner decision not taken. NOT_RUN: `make gate` for this ticket on its own (the authorized single gate run is at the v0-6/v0-7 candidate head); the first criterion was amended to say so. NOT_PRODUCED: a separate acceptance packet; the capability is not advertised as delivered.
